collection.description: A patrol reports strangers near a valuable spring.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patrol reports strangers near a valuable spring.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The strangers retreat, leaving the spring unused by both sides.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The confrontation frightens a child and prompts criticism at home.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The strangers explain that they are lost travelers.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A tense discussion establishes a shared water schedule.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The lack of contact allows fearful rumors to spread.
